text:
Man City vs Fulham: Has Enzo Fernandez given Enzo Maresca a problem in midfield? And how does he fix the imbalance?
Man City have lost their last three Premier League games on the bounce; Enzo Maresca's most used midfield pairing are yet to gel and signs are that their profiles are incompatible; should Enzo Fernandez be dropped altogether or would a higher role suit him and Maresca's system better?
Thursday 19 November 2026 09:08, UK
Enzo Maresca is being forced to work within an unprecedented set of circumstances this season. Up until recently, his fixation on football matters served to quieten the noise around the club. But now the anomalous nature of Manchester City's situation is apparent on and off the pitch.
Maresca began with seven straight wins in all competitions. He has since suffered a hat-trick of Premier League defeats. Concerns over performance levels in certain phases existed from the start but have come into sharper focus as results have nosedived.
Where do the biggest problems lie?
Stylistically, City are far too open; just as easy to play through as play over. Only Newcastle (20) have faced more shots from fast breaks since the start of term than City's 17, conceding two goals from such situations in defeat to Nottingham Forest before the international break.

Transition moments have been City's kryptonite long before the Maresca era. However their current setup leaves them vulnerable to the problem persisting - or worsening. The make-up of Elliot Anderson in a double pivot with Enzo Fernandez is a poor stylistic fit if Rayan Cherki is selected as the other central player. It's too easy to overrun.
Cherki offers virtually nothing out of possession, which is ok if the two deeper lying midfielders work against the ball in tandem. At City this is not the case. Fernandez's positioning and ineffectiveness in duels leaves Anderson far too isolated and even he - one of the team's most reliable performers - got caught at Forest, at fault for Liam Delap's first goal.
City conceded eight fast breaks in total; no team has conceded more in a game this season.
Positionally, Anderson and Fernandez have a tendency to drift into similar areas, both active on the right side of City's midfield. Per 90, the Argentine is tackling less and winning possession less frequently than he did at Chelsea, over-exposing the central third. His offensive numbers do little to make up for the deficit.
At the City Ground, Xaver Schlager and Ryan Yates lapped up the imbalance. Schlager registered a game-high 14 defensive contributions (measured as clearances, blocks, interceptions, and tackles), while Yates racked up 11. Fernandez's tally was four, less than Cherki's five from the bench.
Maresca is taking a big risk playing both. The difficulty is of course also exacerbated by the fact City spent over £320m rebuilding their midfield unit this summer and, so far, the profile of their two hero £100m-plus signings have proved incompatible. That headache is Maresca's to solve.
The Italian is not in the business of copying the model his Spanish predecessor made so successful in his 10 years at City but in this instance it might be worth asking: What would Pep Guardiola do?
Pep teams always created numerical and positional overloads in midfield. Bernardo Silva was the master of such an art and in that sense, has arguably been a greater loss to the City dynamic than Rodri has. Theoretically, pairing Bernardo with Anderson would alleviate many of the out-of-possession mistakes the team are currently making. The issue is a macro one.
And so if City are craving another ball-winner to build greater stability from the base of midfield, one who can also play under pressure, Ayyoub Bouaddi is the obvious choice. The teenager has been under utilised in the league, only managing 177 minutes, and has now had time to settle into his new surroundings.
Bouaddi is a physical presence with great athleticism and would reduce the defensive emphasis on Anderson. He would also have a greater level of positional discipline than Fernandez and therefore adds another layer of resistance against the ball.
For a side who have lacked control and been exposed via structural gaps by the likes of Sunderland, Ipswich and most recently Forest, extra cover is an easy tweak for a quick win. Bouaddi is a readymade No 6.
But packing the midfield does not necessarily mean dropping the player Maresca pushed so hard to sign just two-and-a-half months ago. If this is an exercise in balance, Fernandez at the tip of a midfield triangle could work as an alternative to Cherki - depending on the game plan. This is still a team that thrives in possession and can score from almost anywhere.
Fernandez holds up the ball well, draws fouls, crashes the box with decent timing and can create as well as he can finish. He's yet to score from open play for City but can offer plenty in a free role with adequate cover in behind. Of course the creative merits of Cherki in that function deserve consideration too - but Maresca surely needs to prioritise solidity through his spine given the predicament.
City play Fulham this weekend, having won their last 17 games against them, scoring at least twice each time. This time last year Pep's City shipped four goals at Craven Cottage and yet still ended on the winning side of a 5-4 thriller. Maresca cannot afford to take that gamble.
He must find a way to better protect the backline in transition moments. Or City risk this brand of chaos over control taking permanent hold of a season that already has its fair share of intractable problems.
digest_he:
מנצ'סטר סיטי נקלעה למשבר מקצועי לאחר שלושה הפסדי ליגה רצופים, והבעיות הטקטיות של המאמן אינצו מרסקה באים לידי ביטוי במיוחד במערך הקישור. מרסקה בחר לשלב בקישור האחורי את אנצו פרננדז ואליוט אנדרסון לצד ראיין שרקי הקדמי, אך השילוב מתברר כבעייתי מאוד מבחינה הגנתית. חוסר המשמעות העממית של שרקי מחוץ לכדור, לצד נטייתו של פרננדז לדחוק קדימה ולאבד מאבקים במרכז המגרש, משאירים את אנדרסון חשוף ופוגעים ביכולת העצירה של הקבוצה במעברים מהירים.

הנתונים הסטטיסטיים מראים כי סיטי סובלת מפגיעות חמורה בהתקפות מעבר של היריבות, ומרסקה נדרש למצוא פתרונות מהירים כדי לייצב את מרכז המגרש לקראת המשחק נגד פולהאם. בין האפשרויות העומדות בפניו נמצאת האפשרות לשלב קשר אחורי טבעי כמו איוב בואדי כדי לספק הגנה טובה יותר לקו ההגנה, או לחלופין לנסות את פרננדז בתפקיד התקפי יותר בראש משולש הקישור. הימנעות משינוי טקטי עלולה להעמיק את המשבר ולהותיר את הקבוצה חשופה להמשך העונה.
